title: Machine-Learning
summary: A personal collection of machine learning notes and notebook exercises documenting the author's learning journey. One notebook, Synthetic_Dataset.ipynb, installs SDV and calls sdv.single_table.CTGANSynthesizer (with sdv.metadata.Metadata) to fit and sample synthetic tabular data, and separately imports the standalone ctgan package to run CTGAN directly.
